name: plane
title: Plane
description: Explore work items in Plane and take actions on it
author: saurabhkmr98

commands.name: search-work-items
commands.title: Search Work Items
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Search work items across projects by title or ID

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Browse projects and their work items

commands.name: my-work-items
commands.title: My Work Items
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Work items assigned to you, created by you, or (where the server supports it) subscribed or mentioning you, grouped by state

commands.name: work-items-count
commands.title: My Open Work Items
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Shows how many open work items are assigned to you, and how many are urgent, overdue or due today, in root search. Refreshes every 15 minutes (run it once to start); opening it shows My Work Items.

commands.name: open-work-item
commands.title: Open Work Item
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Open a work item by ID (e.g. ENG-123) or Plane URL, or from the clipboard

commands.name: quick-create-work-item
commands.title: Quick Create Work Item
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Create a work item in your default project without opening a form

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Project identifier to create work items in, e.g. ENG

preferences.name: assignToMe
preferences.label: Assign to me
preferences.description: Assign new work items to yourself

commands.name: quick-add-comment
commands.title: Quick Add Comment
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Add a Markdown comment to a work item by ID

commands.name: assigned-work-items-menu-bar
commands.title: Assigned Work Items
commands.subtitle: Plane
commands.description: Show your open assigned work items in the menu bar

preferences.name: alwaysShow
preferences.label: Always Show
preferences.description: Show the menu bar item even when nothing is assigned to you

preferences.title: API Base Path
preferences.name: API_BASE_PATH
preferences.description: Your Plane API base path, e.g. https://plane.example.com for self-hosted (a trailing slash or /api is fine)

preferences.title: App Base URL
preferences.name: APP_BASE_URL
preferences.description: Your Plane web app URL, e.g. https://plane.example.com for self-hosted

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
